title: P1: handoff.py atomicity bug - node orphaned on partial failure
description:
File: python/src/lichen/gateway/handoff.py
Line: 525

In NodeRegistry.handle_handoff_request(), the node is unregistered (line 525) BEFORE the HandoffResponse is returned. If the caller fails to send the response or it is lost in transit:
- Source gateway has already removed the node from registry
- Target gateway never receives state
- Node becomes orphaned (not registered anywhere)

The spec (docstring lines 7-12) describes a 5-step handoff where step 3 is 'A releases node from its registry, sends confirmation'. This implementation releases first, then returns the response for sending -- the release should be conditional on successful delivery.

Fix: Either use a two-phase commit (mark as 'pending handoff', then finalize on ACK), or defer unregister() until after caller confirms response was sent. Alternatively, add a timeout-based cleanup where orphaned nodes are re-registered if no confirm is received.

SECURITY: This enables denial-of-service by triggering handoffs and blocking responses.
